name: ai-ppt-studio
description: A Codex-native governed workspace for planning, designing, producing, and validating editable business presentations.

interface.shortDescription: Plan and deliver high-design editable PPTs in a native Codex workbench.
interface.longDescription: AI PPT Studio turns Codex into a governed presentation delivery workspace. It externalizes the Agent's project cognition, keeps human decisions and evidence versioned, and coordinates content, visual direction, editable PPT production, rendering, and acceptance without a separate web app.
defaultPrompt: 在 Codex 侧边栏打开 AI PPT Studio，继续我最近的项目。
创建一个售前解决方案 PPT 项目，并先澄清汇报对象与目标。
查看当前项目的 AI 认知地图和最需要我判断的问题。
